touches.text: system_word: case-folding for system words (device names, verbs, statuses). WHY: anything you type is case-insensitive. USERS: everyone that parses a command.

artifact: the one door a record of truth changes through, and the journal of who came through it (hash-chained, caller read from the kernel). WHY: errors are permanent in records of truth (Law 7), and the journal is what shows a record moved by hand. USERS: everyone who writes a record.
Shareable provenance (charters, tickets, validations) is git JSON beside the code, never a row.

Scripts are Python wherever possible, run by Cairn's own interpreter, so one file works on every platform. Platform-specific ones match their platform: executable or .sh on Linux; .bat, .cmd or .ps1 on Windows.
